invariants.rationale: activeModule may be expected to be a meaningful module identifier and is unlikely intended to be null.
activityDescription may be expected to provide a status description and is likely required to be non-null.
If activeModule is meant to represent a non-empty module, its length should be positive.
A meaningful activity description should be non-empty.
It is likely that activeModule and activityDescription represent different concepts, so they should not be equal.
